supervision_windows.note: cutoff 250 is the fixed TRAIN cutoff of the prior v2 engineering cohort for this episode; targets are the 11 subsequent capture-step frames
one-step horizon: 5 ticks = 0.5 s physical time

fit_policy.fit_input_rule: tick <= cutoff records of TRAIN episodes only; VALID/TEST fit raises NormalizationScopeError
fit_policy.max_fit_tick_reporting: scaler.scope_document() records the largest tick that entered the fit

split_group_policy.rule: source_family and split_group derive from the ORIGINAL scenario/seed key <scenario>_v<N>__seed<M>; every old/new copy, 36overlay and normal/congested branch, and every supervision window built from one source shares exactly that original's single split group; versions are not independent examples
split_group_policy.table_source: host_data_v2/cohort.json (prior v2 engineering cohort TRAIN/VALID assignment, verified episode-by-episode in tests/unit/test_split_provenance.py)
split_group_policy.decorated_ids: variant marks after '::' or '++' are preserved verbatim and never create a new split group; TEST originals are not present in the old cohort and are not invented here
split_group_policy.unknown: any episode id outside the verified grammar raises instead of guessing

transported_q.producer: historical P01 diagnostic export (pre-v4 lineage; produced outside this package)
transported_q.mechanism: TRUE future values + TRAIN-frozen Gaussian noise (parent supplement declaration)
transported_q.enforcement: p01v4.data.provenance.reject_transported_inputs raises on any input-branch record of this family

available_time.capture_bound: established for pilot rgb/lidar: content available at the same-run capture tick, bound via p01v4.data.provenance.capture_binding_record
available_time.hindsight_truth: truth frames/edges/events: content tick definitive, inadmissible as input after cutoff
available_time.unknown: kept explicit with tick=None and a note; never fabricated

leak_audit.future_truth: p01v4.data.windows.reject_future_truth_inputs rejects truth records with tick > cutoff AND input records whose provenance available_time.tick > cutoff
leak_audit.future_visibility_topology: p01v4.data.windows.audit_input_selector perturbs all future field content and requires selector membership to be unchanged; a flip is a future-visibility/topology leak and raises

six_point_supplement_policy.revisions: v14 PACKAGE source_revision is separate from per-dimension producer_revision; a 36x8 package label never proves all eight producers changed; per-dimension actual source files mapped in p01v4.data.provenance.package_revision_document (unprovided dimensions stay producer_revision=null)
six_point_supplement_policy.views: lossless archive view (full event_script/scene_setup, future fault/weather schedule, terminal/hidden control, semantic episode names) is address/archive-only; model_visible_view admits only capture_bound/hindsight_truth content with tick <= cutoff; known-plan experiments need separate labels
six_point_supplement_policy.transported_q: ORACLE_ONLY (TRUE future + TRAIN-frozen Gaussian noise), never a prediction input
six_point_supplement_policy.splits: ORIGINAL scenario+seed decides; all versions/overlays/load branches/windows share one split; new-scenario generalization claims require the ENTIRE scenario with all seeds held out
six_point_supplement_policy.lp_definitions: legacy q-based L/P (L/p01-legacy-q-bounded-observation) and TTL L/P (L/p01-ttl-observation-actual-available-time) are distinct definition_id; timely cases count actual available_time<=cutoff; no timely RX means L undefined (never zero); pending/censored compute tasks stay censored without hindsight outcomes
six_point_supplement_policy.capture: actual capture binds same run/pose/weather/clock (capture_binding_record); 181 planned capture times never prove 181 successful frames - pilot actual counted frames are 11 rgb + 11 lidar (manifest pilot-import.json); NOT_RECOMPUTED is unknown, not zero events

leak_checks: input tick <= cutoff for every input record
future frame/observation content only on the target branch
input-set selection depends only on tick <= cutoff, never on visibility or any field value
scaler fit restricted to TRAIN split and tick <= cutoff
engineering_test_scope.generalization_claim: windows built here reuse the same episode for engineering tests; NO cross-episode generalization is claimed from them
